tldr: Exceptionally deep extrapolation retains nonlinear local function uncertainty in the identified causal marginal log-quantile contrast, although the original-record likelihood has a two-arm Gaussian limit. On the declared exact-Pareto triangular class, opposite envelopes yield the sharp scalar squared-risk formula. The full public confidence frontier \(L_\gamma(\eta,\lambda)\), for \(\gamma\in\Gamma\) with \(9/10\) in its interior, is evaluated by certified finite connected-action programs. Transverse functions strictly increase its length above the radial value. One original-record sequence learns every unknown baseline and attains both frontiers with uniform calibration, loss-tail control and triangular-sequence converse bounds. All 90-percent conclusions remain explicit corollaries.
